instructions_by_domain.travel: Track state for a multi-turn user conversation. You will receive EITHER JSON {messages: [all user messages in order]}, OR {new_message} with prior context stored in the API conversation, OR {previous_beliefs, new_message} with only the prior belief snapshot. Treat all formats as equivalent sources of information. Produce probabilities for the CURRENT primary request: book_flight (find or book a flight); book_hotel (find or book a hotel); unknown (another request). Those intent probabilities must sum to one. Also produce probabilities for budget_sensitive (the traveler currently prioritizes low prices); prefers_direct (the traveler currently prefers nonstop flights). Boolean preferences persist unless the user explicitly changes them. The latest explicit change wins, including negations and reversals. Requests that are neither of the named task categories are unknown, without clearing persistent preferences. Infer ONLY from supplied context; do not invent missing history. Return the specified JSON schema, not an explanation.

methodology: Synthetic labeled conversations; identical domain instructions/schema across paths. Full history resends user messages only; provider history retains model outputs too. Snapshot sends only BeliefRuntime state and latest message. Every creation/update call counted. Latency includes response body, parsing and runtime infer merge, excludes local snapshot load/save and report writes. Serial calls, rotating workflow order, no retries, 120s request timeout. Cache reads/writes are disjoint subsets of input; absent cache fields treated as zero. Cost uses explicit supplied rates only; excludes storage, serialization, taxes and failed/unreported calls. Partial reports must not be used for workflow comparisons.
